reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, and I have a drawer full of half-used bottles. Sachets are neat, but I don't need magnesium to go, so I'd just scroll past.
objection: I already have magnesium at home and I take it there every night. Paying $30 for a travel format of something I already own feels like adding one more bottle to the drawer I never finish.
would_change_my_mind: If I were about to travel a lot and my current bottle was empty, or if one cheap trial box (around $10) let me try it without committing to a month.
